scope: Discover lab card inset correction; secondary framing is inspection-only; production unchanged
command: DESIGN_SYSTEM_PORT=3043 pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.design-system.config.ts --project=design-system-review discover-cards-lab-regressions.spec.ts

tests.name: Discover cards retain sorting across the available-width boundary
Discover resize does not reclaim focus after an outside interaction

assertions: 24px total header and Market Cap content insets, 24px footer bottom padding, square card/media, matching steady fills, complete grid-cell coverage, loading parity, sorting/focus, motion and navigation. 2px surround/seams check lab framing only, not a product contract.
limitations: Six selected static viewport captures from 24 attachments. Motion is disabled in screenshots and checked separately. Some offline token logos use fallback artwork. Not production adoption or design acceptance.
